messages:
maya (eng-ml): heads up — i'm starting bring‑up for model xg-3b-quant on staging, want to lock down the QA/regression gates before we schedule a canary. proposing a short checklist + pass/fail thresholds. quick read pls :eyes:

raj (eng-runtime): +1. what's the perf target? we need sensible p95 SLOs to decide whether to route to dedicated.

maya (eng-ml): perf targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms with current batching config. if we can't hit p95 we fallback to xg-3b-fp16 on latency-critical routes.

olivia (product): want strict user-facing quality gates. suggest: no more than 2% drop on our core NLU promptset, no regression on hallucination checks, toxicity must be <= baseline. also flag format/JSON schema breaks.

chao (eng-ml): proposed eval harness run and thresholds: 
- run: `./eval_harness --model xg-3b-quant --promptset prompts/core_nlu.json --seed 42 --mode full`
- pass if: top1 accuracy delta >= -2.0% (vs baseline 88.9), exact match drop <= 1.5%, hallucination score not increase by >0.5 pts, toxicity delta <= 0.0
- perf pass if: p95 <= 350ms and token cost delta <= +8%

maya (eng-ml): adding a smaller smoke set for quick gating pre-canary: prompts/smoke_regress.json (50 examples). smoke pass rules: accuracy delta >= -3% OR no high-severity hallucinations in top-3 completions.

iris (eng-sre): we should also include an infra-safety gate: no OOMs in 1000 concurrent synthetic requests, and no >0.5% error rate under 2x baseline QPS. can we automate a synthetic load test?

raj (eng-runtime): yes, I can add a k6 job in the canary harness. draft k6 snippet: ```js
export default function() {
  http.post("https://staging-api.redwood/test/generate", JSON.stringify({model: 'xg-3b-quant', prompt: 'ping'}));
}
```
will fail the gate if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 1.5x baseline.

olivia (product): also please include manual spot checks for hallucination categories we care about (facts about pricing, personal data, legal disclaimers). allocate ~10 manual items.

chao (eng-ml): i'll add automated evals: BLEU/Rouge/EM for structured tasks, a factuality classifier score, and our custom hallucination heuristics. harness will output a single summary JSON like: `{"accuracy":87.3, "baseline":88.9, "delta":-1.6, "p95_ms":312, "toxicity":0.02}`

maya (eng-ml): sample smoke run command for CI: 
```bash
./ci/run_smoke.sh --model xg-3b-quant --prompts prompts/smoke_regress.json --results out/smoke.json
cat out/smoke.json | jq .summary
```

eval-bot: smoke run completed for thread 1765432109 at 1765432235
```json
{
  "accuracy": 87.3,
  "baseline": 88.9,
  "delta": -1.6,
  "p95_ms": 312,
  "toxicity": 0.02,
  "ooms": 0,
  "error_rate": 0.12
}
```

maya (eng-ml): that smoke result => within thresholds (delta -1.6% < -2% threshold? actually better than our -2% floor so PASS), p95 OK, infra OK. good quick signal.

olivia (product): good start. schedule a canary only after full harness runs (full promptsets + manual checks). can we make a doc with the exact pass criteria? i want a 1‑pager to share with PMs.

chao (eng-ml): will draft gating doc and PR to infra repo. tentative checklist in the doc: 
- [ ] smoke harness run (50 examples) -> pass rules listed
- [ ] full eval harness (all promptsets) -> numeric pass/fail
- [ ] manual hallucination review (10 items) -> signoff by product
- [ ] infra stress test (k6 1000 conc) -> signoff by eng-runtime/eng-sre
- [ ] deploy canary config + rollback policy in console
- [ ] post-canary metrics (quality degradation alerts)

iris (eng-sre): i'll add alerting: if post-canary error rate >0.3% or user-reported regressions spike (tracked via support-tagged issues) we auto-rollback.

raj (eng-runtime): i'll wire the p95 and error_rate checks into the rollout controller so canary halts on breach.

maya (eng-ml): action items: 
- chao: PR with gating doc + manifest for eval harness (due EOD Tue)
- raj: add k6 job + integrate p95/error gating (due Wed)
- iris: set up post-canary alerts and runbook (due Wed)
- olivia: prepare manual spot-check items and signoff criteria (due Tue)

olivia (product): noted. tagging @maya for followups. :thumbsup:

maya (eng-ml): thanks all — i'll schedule the full eval once the PR is up. moving thread to pinned refs in #eng-ml for visibility.

end of thread
